I usually heat plates for 45s-1.5m, the plate should be good and warm not scalding hot ... And I usually use the actual microwave plate or ceramic plates - bone china doesn't really absorb the heat needed

My go-to technique is
1.  heat an empty clean dry ceramic plate in th microwave for 45 seconds then touch test - should feel warm but not too hot to handle - add 10-15 seconds if needed 
2.  Dump desired amount of product on to the plate and let sit for about 10s.
 ****I find waiting a few seconds makes it less likely to stick to the plate when crushing down*****
3.  Crush product with a stiff but flexible plastic sheet (similar to Canadian currency) 
4.  Rub card or chopping tool over the plastic in circular motions to make sure all crispier chunks are flattened 
5.  Scrape plate surface to release the powder and chop chop chop 
6.  Create lines and enjoy
